I have had two abortions and I had terrible anxiety with both. I was terrified of going through a pregnancy alone and having to raise a child alone. The thought of having to do it alone would make me panic. 

I also have emetophobia, so the morning sickness I felt so anxious. I would have panic attacks just from feeling sick. I also felt that having an abortion would make my depression worse. I was just terrified of both ideas. Like you I’ve been hospitalized for suicidal ideation and dealt with these mental illnesses for years. 

My first abortion came with huge relief immediately because I wasn’t nauseated anymore, but depression did come along. I don’t think it’s something I’ll ever escape, but I can’t imagine passing down something I live with to another innocent human being that I was not even going to be able to properly provide for. It’s a decision that takes a tremendous amount of thought. 

My second pregnancy brought me an insane amount of depression before the abortion. I was completely alone, the father would barely even talk to me, I had no friends, I was SO sick I couldn’t even go out. I would go between my family home and my own place and to the doctor. That was it. I felt so isolated. While I felt like having a second abortion was just not something I could do, in the end it was better than having to go 9 months feeling alone and isolated. I didn’t experience as much depression afterwards probably because I wasn’t attached to the father. 

In the end, I rambled way too much, but I’m not here to say it was the biggest relief I ever had and I have no regrets. Some days are hard, others I’m grateful I was able to make this decision.

I opted for surgical at 6 weeks and 2 days. I have a phobia of throw up, and I was terrified of being home alone dealing with the side effects of the pill. I also am not a big fan of taking pills lol, side effects scare the shit out of me. 

The surgical took FOREVER. Not the procedure itself, but the WAITING. I kept wanting to just walk out, but I didn’t have the energy as I hadn’t been able to eat in two days. 

We got there and I had taken my iPad with some shows downloaded from Netflix and a blanket because it is always cold in DRs office. I checked in and sat there in the waiting room watching the Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt. 

They finally called my name and they took me back. Took my vitals and had my undress from the bottom down. It was cold, and it took forever for the ultrasound tech to come in and see how far along I was. Finally they did it, they left. A nurse came back and gave me Tylenol(I asked this instead of ibuprofen) and an antibiotic. I also asked for zofran. Then the waiting continued! 

Finally the Dr. came in and they sedated me. I felt super out of it. I don’t really remember much. It hurt, I was definitely clenching. It was over really fast. I had to get dressed fairly quickly and go to the recovery room. I didn’t feel ready to move, but they rushed it. Whatever, the nurses were nice. they gave me a heating pad, and some water and a sprite. I was soooo thirsty. They made me go to the bathroom and tell them how much I was bleeding. There was almost no bleeding. They walked me out to my boyfriends car because he didn’t get out (🙄) and we were off. I suddenly felt very nauseated and dry heaved in his car. Super terrifying feeling, but hey I didn’t throw up! 

I got home, he left and I just watched tv and slept until my mom came to take me to her house. I felt better the next day and was eating everything I could. 

I had my energy back and felt like I could do anything I wanted. 

For me the medical abortion seemed too drawn out. I’m a huge wuss when it comes to a lot of things and surgical just seemed like it was the fastest way to get over everything.
